column3: The exact same image as the reference: same character, same face, same camera angle, same scale, same horizontal position on the canvas, same outfit, same comic style, plain pure white background. The ONLY change: he sits on the floor cross-legged, seen from the front, arms crossed over his chest, calm face; his body is lower on the canvas because he is sitting.
